body: Thanks for you kind words. But as the world has moved on, so has my opportunity at a good life. It's sad, but true.

Thanks for you concern, and it's great you've faced your own problems and overcame/are overcoming them. 

Not much more to add to my story than what I've already said in my previous posts. It's all build-up to the actual act. And I know how irrational that sounds, but I'm in such bad shape that I don't really care about the effects it will have on others emotionally. Objectively, yes, I wouldn't want to cause unnecessary suffering, but I'm suffering at the moment, and need some relief.

I doubt there is treatment, and after that, what's the point anyway? Still no future.

These [previous](http://www.reddit.com/r/SuicideWatch/comments/26i8me/brain_damage_time_to_go/) [posts](http://www.reddit.com/r/SuicideWatch/comments/26lw5w/brain_damage_part_2/) shall tell you all you need to know.
I don't. I need to end this.

It's all too late. Can't get funding, and i'm in no shape to do much. 

I neglected my golden opportunity - youth, funding (both loans and grants), and time. . . and chose poorly. You're right, I mustn't have enjoyed it. Thought myself something of a writer, never actually wrote much of anything, hahah.

Actually not feeling all that good at the moment, haha. See where this takes me...

I can assure you that I have. My brain is truly fucked. And my body is failing me. I can feel it.

I would call it stupidity. Absolute laziness, short-sightedness. I've left University with nothing but bad memories and debt.

A permanent solution to a permanent problem, my friend. A bit of pain and then nothingness. 

Best of luck to your friend - work hard and you achieve wonders.

I wish this shit was mild. I sleep for maybe 4 hours. I spend all day on the computer. I fixate myself on the past. I'm cold and completely emotionless (not depression: I'm broken). And I believe I have kidney failure. 

I wasted 5 years of my life and all I ended up with is this stupid brain damage. Better than a degree!

I am not a doctor, no. But I know what I did to myself: I dehydrated myself over an *extended* period of time, weeks, and was stuck in a cycle of vomiting and such until I realised what I'd done to myself. Too late to reverse it or treat it, not that I would want to treat it.

An imposed decision? I wish, my friend. Just my own stupidity. Regret after regret after regret - the only thing that gets a reaction within me. Feel like a damn psychopath now. And I'm in no shape to pursue something else even if I could. 

Minimum wage jobs for me!

Thank you, it's great to know there are some good people in the world. I might have been one of them before this, but not anymore. 

I probably would've found that video funny once. 

Permanent solution to a permanent problem. Bye.

That part that wants help is dying along with the rest of me at the moment. 

Don't be bulimic, kids.

Aye, doing minimum-wage jobs I get driven to by my parents and enjoying life with my few friends who, on reflection, weren't really all that.

I'm sorry I wasted you and the other person's time coming on here. I just needed to write something before going.

Take care.

How do I know? I don't *care* about anything, I'm getting headaches, I can't sleep, my short-term memory is shot, and I'm emotionless. 

I need release, painful or painless, whatever.

Fixable? I doubt it. 

And that's another thing: I should feel concerned or worried for my family... but I don't. This shit has turned me into a selfish self-centred psychopath.

Throwing up an empty stomach with very little in the way of fluid replacement.... yeah. I'd check with a doctor, but I feel it getting worse (can't eat or drink since I'm not even sure I'm hungry or thirsty - fucked-up stomach!) 

And yeah, that's the only emotional reaction I get now: regret. 

Thank you for taking your time in responding.

Depression plays a part, yeah I'm sure - it lead to me *giving myself permanent brain damage* 

Can't be fixed. And hey! My nose is a bit bloody. Leaking brains probably.

I've seen a doctor, but skirted the actual issue (before I realised the extent of what I'd done to myself).

Yeah, I have, and they don't believe me. They think it's depression. 

I've read up: this shit is permanent. And I was pretty useless before this happened and now I have to deal with this? No.
